summary: This task is a new domain variant (research stipends) of the existing multi-source reconciliation pattern. Key differences from existing patterns: (1) Campus field validation alongside amount/account, (2) Award-level state checking ('archived' vs 'active'), (3) Revision handling where campus_code can change across revisions, (4) Name matching with initials ('Amara S.' → 'Amara Singh'). The existing skill handles most of this but needs explicit coverage for campus field mismatches and award-level state validation. The trace shows successful execution with no failures, so the patch adds documentation of this variant and extends the template script to handle campus/cross-field validation.
